timelineData.title: Elon Musk Calls AI Humanity's Biggest Existential Threat
timelineData.details: During an interview at the MIT Aeronautics and Astronautics department’s Centennial Symposium, Elon Musk called AI humanity's biggest existential threat

timelineData.title: Altman Publishes Blog Post Stating 'AI is scary'
timelineData.details: Altman publishes blog post stating that AI is scary. The obvious solution is to spare no expense in trying to build it as quickly as possible. At least that's the solution that lets you drive around in a $4 million Koenigsegg. He looked pretty worried behind the wheel. Maybe he should have sat on a phonebook.

timelineData.title: OpenAI Launched
timelineData.details: OpenAI was founded in 2015 in Delaware as a nonprofit.

timelineData.title: OpenAI Receives $130 Million Grant
timelineData.details: OpenAI receives $130 million grant from Peter Thiel, Reid Hoffman, Jessica Livingston, Infosys, YC Research, Amazon Web Services

timelineData.title: Nvidia Donates DGX-1 Computer to OpenAI
timelineData.details: Nvidia donates DGX-1 to OpenAI

timelineData.title: Fermi America Secures $785 Million in Financing
timelineData.details: For it's first quarter, 2026 earnings report, Fermi America secured $785 million in financing, and lost $189 million.

timelineData.title: Nvidia Buys $2 Billion in CoreWeave Stock
timelineData.details: Nvidia buys $2 billion in CoreWeave stock. CoreWeave buys chips from Nvidia to build AI data centers.

timelineData.title: Nvidia Claims That It Is Not Enron
timelineData.details: No one said Nvidia was Enron, but Nvidia felt the need to make sure everyone knew. Nvidia sent a memo to employees stating that 'Nvidia is not Enron', and that the company is financially healthy. Now everyone thinks Nvidia is Enron and is wondering about the company's financial health.

timelineData.title: OpenAI Misses Revenue and User Targets
timelineData.details: According to the Wall Steet Journal, 'Chief Financial Officer Sarah Friar has told other company leaders that she is worried the company might not be able to pay for future computing contracts if revenue doesn't grow fast enough.'

timelineData.title: Dario Amodei Gives 60 Minutes Interview
timelineData.details: Dario Amodei gives an interview to Anderson Cooper on 60 Minutes. He claims that AI could wipe out half of entry level white collar jobs. Amodei continues to try to paint himself as the 'responsible' AI executive. Cooper never asks why, if AI is so dangerous, Amodei, the paragon of ethical responsibility, doesn't shut down Claude and devote the rest of his life to stopping AI development.

timelineData.title: Nvidia Announces Letter of Intent to Invest Up to $100 Billion in OpenAI
timelineData.details: Nvidia releases letter of intent to invest up to $100 billion in OpenAI. Nvidia says they will release $10 billion tranches as OpenAI completes each gigawatt of a planned 10GW compute buildout. Months before anyone else, Ed Zitron analyzed Nvidia's earnings statement an called that Nvidia would never give OpenAI the money.

timelineData.title: Anthropic Secures $30 Billion Funding Round
timelineData.details: Anthropic secures $30 billion funding round and is valued at $900 billion. Leading investors include Dragoneer, Greenoaks, Sequoia Capital, and Altimeter Capital.

timelineData.title: Jensen Huang Walks Back Nvidia's $100 Billion OpenAI Commitment
timelineData.details: Jensen Huang walks back Nvidia's $100 billion OpenAI commitment. Turns out a letter of intent is not a legally binding contract. Good job skirting fraud regulations, scumbags.

timelineData.title: Anthropic Files Affidavit That Reveals Only $5 Billion Lifetime Revenue
timelineData.details: Anthropic CFO Krishna Rao says revenue exeeded $5 billion to date. This doesn't equal the sum of previous annualized revenue claims. Looks like fraud and quacks like fraud.

timelineData.title: AI 2027 is Published
timelineData.details: Written by Daniel Kokotajlo, Scott Alexander, Thomas Larsen, Eli Lifland, Romeo Dean; AI 2027 predicts human extinction at the hands of LLMs. The report demonstrates a fundamental lack of understanding of how LLMs work. AI models really are just auto-complete with some added psychological tricks to drive engagement. AI 2027 ascribes motivations and capabilities to LLMs that just don't exist.

timelineData.title: Grok Becomes MechaHitler
timelineData.details: An LLM will just try to predict the correct way to continue a sentence based on the context window and its training data. Who would have ever thought that the LLM owned by Elon Musk, the man who gives heartfelt salutes and talks about white genocide, would be weighted toward antisemetic responses? When Musk had the engineers at xAI relax the model's guardrails so it wouldn't be so 'woke', did he really nazi what would happen?

timelineData.title: Residents of Cascade Locks, Oregon stop $100 million data center project
timelineData.details: Local activists in Cascade Locks, Oregon stopped a 10MW data center from being built. Two officials that had supported the project lost recall elections and two others lost regular elections. It's good to see democracy work.

timelineData.title: Voters in Warrenton, VA elect 5 Members to Town Council to Oppose Data Centers
timelineData.details: Five citizens of Warrenton, VA became council members after having campaigned on a platform in opposition to data centers. The new council members were elected after the previous council had approved a 220,000 square foot Amazon data center in a 4-3 vote. All four of the sellouts were asked to get out by the People.

timelineData.title: OpenAI and Oracle Cancel 600MW Data Center Expansion
timelineData.details: OpenAI's Stargate Abilene was supposed to get an additional 600MW of compute capacity. The data center complex is being built by Crusoe for Oracle to rent the compute to OpenAI. Reportedly, Oracle and OpenAI were unable to agree on financing arrangements. I'm sure it's nothing.

timelineData.title: OpenAI Kills Sora
timelineData.details: Only months after releasing Sora 2, OpenAI discontinued its video generation product. Turns out it isn't profitable to burn compute making full-motion slop, not that it's profitable to make static slop, but full-motion slop is especially unprofitable.

timelineData.title: $500 Billion Stargate Project Announced
timelineData.details: The Stargate Project was a joint venture between OpenAI, Oracle, Softbank and MGX to build up to half a trillion dollars worth of data centers for LLMs. The project was announced by Donald Trump, Larry Ellison, Masayoshi Son and Sam Altman. It was like a Liars Anonymous meeting. A small sampling of the unsupported claims made: 100,000 jobs will be created almost immediately, we'll be amazed at the rate we're curing cancers and heart disease, 'The Golden Age' is beginning, AGI and superintelligence are on the way, we couldn't have done this without you Mr. President.
